# mg-styles-15, in RasanAI

Reference: [Vincentwei1021/mg-styles-15](https://github.com/Vincentwei1021/mg-styles-15), MIT (`LICENSE`, `NOTICE`). Fifteen 10-second film prompts, one per motion-graphics idiom, each ending in "signature features and key techniques" that a jury scores for style fidelity.

| Here | From | Used by |
|---|---|---|
| `LICENSE` | `LICENSE` (exact copy) | |
| `library/styles/<slug>.md` for 15 styles (flat-vector, line-art, isometric, 3d-render, cel-boil, collage, liquid, morph, bauhaus, synthwave, aurora-glass, hanazi, paperclip, pixel, hud) | `prompts/<n>-<slug>.md` seed, rules and signature features (translated, condensed, in our words) | the design desk, the design-system designers |
| `library/styles/posters/<slug>.jpg` | `videos/<n>-<slug>.jpg` (resized to 480 px wide) | the style files |
| The "signature features" idea: `## Signature features` in every DESIGN.md (3 to 6 checkable traits) the frame juror and critic check by name | the prompts' "Signature features" block and `rubric.md`'s style_fidelity dimension (the idea, no text) | `references/design-desk.md`, `agents/design-system-designer.md`, the frame juror and critic |

Not taken: demo code, audio scripts, fonts, textures, photos, videos, the site.
